scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -R LICENSE manifest.json *.html *.css *.js icons vendor dist/
scripts.zip: npm test && npm run build && V=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && rm -f checkmate-$V.zip && cd dist && zip -qrX ../checkmate-$V.zip . && echo "Created checkmate-$V.zip"
